verdict: No real signature, context, mathematical, Chinese-terminology or placeholder defect detected in the 17 trilingual records. Preserve the original readbacks.json unchanged; no readbacks-final.json is necessary.
review_method: Compared the five actual Definitions/Theorems files directly, with the imported concrete definitions as context. No author README, source-consumer prose or shape report was used to infer a statement. No compilation or original-paper source check was performed.

integration_schema.instruction: Use the nested language fields from the original artifact. Any uploader normalization should preserve the raw readback artifact; this review does not rewrite its schema.

checks.topic: Full algebraic closure and projective point carrier
checks.detail: Qbar is the actual AlgebraicClosure ℚ alias. Pt is Option Qbar, with none as infinity. Galois stability ranges over every Qbar ℚ-algebra automorphism and actual members of the finite set; it is not restricted to rational points or a selected finite subextension.

checks.topic: Actual elementary maps, evaluation and ramification conjunction
checks.detail: The common context matches the imported rational Mobius and positive-degree polynomial constructors, actual projective evaluation (including zero denominator and infinity), actual rootMultiplicity polynomial difference, and head-first list evaluation. The source predicate is exactly: every source-set point maps into {∞,0,1}; the distinguished point maps outside it; every projective point with composite ramification index >1 maps into it. All three conditions and the unrestricted third quantifier are present in every expanded predicate readback.

checks.topic: Fixed complex embedding and norm conditions
checks.detail: ι is the one noncomputably selected ℚ-algebra map Qbar→ℂ, with the algebraicity instance local in its definition. The readbacks use its injectivity as a field embedding and the same chosen map in all norm bounds. Rational restriction and complex norm=real absolute value are exact. No arbitrary norm law, extra global instance or all-complex-embeddings quantifier is introduced.

The same existential u,T₁ serve every d and every continuation list hs. T₁ is Galois-stable and complex-norm bounded by one. Degree bounds transfer for every d≥1; the count of points of degree exactly d does not increase under the additional condition d≥2. A continuation valid at distinguished point 9 for withInf(T₁) becomes valid at the original rational τ for withInf(T), with u applied first. No bound is asserted for d=0.

The finite set has actual complex norm ≤1 and minimal-polynomial degree ≤1. No Galois-stability assumption is added. The distinguished point is the fixed rational 9. The output is a list satisfying the entire source conjunction.

checks.topic: Minimal-polynomial step and descending highest-degree count
checks.detail: All inputs remain: Galois stability, the actual fixed-embedding bound, d≥2, degrees≤d, degree-d count≤n+1, and an actual σ₀∈T of degree d. The output preserves degrees≤d while replacing the degree-d count bound by ≤n. T₂ is a finite subset of Qbar, not claimed to be a subset of T or to satisfy a new norm bound. τ₂ is rational and outside T₂. The existential elementary map transports every valid later list for T₂,τ₂ back to T,9, in the correct composition order.

core_key quantifies every natural d,n, a Galois-stable finite T, degree bound≤d and degree-d count≤n, and every rational τ outside T. No norm bound occurs in its type; d=0 and n=0 are allowed. The written proof has strong outer induction on d and inner induction on n: the zero-top-count branch lowers d, while Minpoly lowers the count under the same d. The private general withInf theorem discharges bounds by finite sup/card choices, and has no degree/count/norm assumptions in its type. Both private declarations are covered without inventing compiler-mangled names.

checks.topic: Existing zero-specialized parent and open dependencies
checks.detail: The parent allows infinity in its finite Galois-stable source set but excludes some(0). It concludes the full three-condition property at the specifically excluded source point zero, without adding degree or norm bounds. The three source reduction statements remain explicit sorry leaves; both private combination helpers and the parent remain marked as depending on those leaves rather than as closed proofs.

checks.topic: Chinese terminology and trilingual quantifier agreement
checks.detail: Chinese degree/ramification/root-multiplicity/finite-set-cardinality terms match their actual uses. Cardinalities count distinct finite-set members rather than polynomial root multiplicities. English, Chinese and Japanese preserve all conditions and the normalizer and minimal-polynomial continuation directions; no cosmetic rewrite was made.

This review has not checked elaboration, typeclass synthesis, tactic execution or axioms. The 17 matching source signature strings are exact source text, not a compiler type report.
